# An effect's @update and a list's change events run on the interpreter and
# are lowered on no compiled target yet. A target refuses one where it is
# written rather than emitting a bracket that never reports.

! sngl generate --platform html --lang js -o out app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:7:22: an effect''s @update is not implemented on any compiled target yet'

! sngl generate --platform fyne --lang go -o out app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:7:22: an effect''s @update is not implemented on any compiled target yet'

sngl test app.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

component saver ui.node {
    var xs list<int> = []
    var saved = 0
    effect(on = xs, @update {
        saved += 1
    })

    func add() {
        xs.push(1)
    }

    ui.text #out(value = "{saved}")
}

func testSaves(t test.Test, c saver) {
    c.add()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "1")
}

ui.window(title = "Saver") {
    saver
}
